answer.summary: ArchRuleRegistrationTest fails deterministically: the rule TenantActiveTableAccessArchTest#scenario_revisions_repository_access_is_reviewed is not annotated @ArchTest and not listed in HELPERS, so the ArchUnit meta-test rejects it. This is a repeatable code/config problem, not flakiness, so a rerun will fail the same way. The touched-file list shows only front-end files and fds-migration, so the offending Java rule is probably in the branch but not listed; check the scenario-revisions architecture test and register or annotate it. The Shibboleth HEAD retry and the Jackson parse error logged earlier are noise and do not cause the failure.

evidence.quote: [these rules are not annotated @ArchTest, so the ArchUnit engine never runs them: annotate them, or list them in HELPERS with the class that runs them]
